name: 描眉画目·定制美学
description: A private studio for brow design grounded in your features and bone structure. Specialising in instrument hair-stroke brows, we consider contour, natural hair flow and your own style to bring the brows into harmony with the whole face.

design_principles.summary: Grounded in each person’s bone structure, main strokes establish structure and fine strokes enrich the layers. Individual brow design brings the brows into harmony with the other features, seeking a more fluid, dimensional and natural overall appearance.

sections.title: Brow design grounded in bone structure and facial harmony
paragraphs: Lele’s brow design always begins with each person’s own features and bone structure, rather than a fixed brow template.

Before designing, she considers the depth, visual weight and overall character of the features, the height and prominence of the cheekbones and brow bone, the relationship between brows and eyes, and the direction of the existing brow hairs.

Working with the existing bone structure, she adjusts the position and curvature of the brow start, arch and tail, along with the overall contour, to refine facial proportions visually and balance the relationship between the cheekbones and eye area. The aim is a smoother, more open visual flow, with natural depth and definition between facial planes.

sections.title: Main strokes establish structure; fine strokes build layers
paragraphs: Lele pays close attention to the framework, structure and layers of hair flow within the brows.

In hair-stroke brow designs suited to a combination of main and fine strokes, the main strokes first establish the primary structure and direction of hair flow, bringing out the visual relationship between the brows and brow bone.

Delicate, fine strokes then introduce variations in density, tone, and the balance of defined and subtle lines. The strokes connect naturally, giving the brow a clear contour and structure while retaining the lightness and softness of natural hair.
The result sought is more than density alone: a brow with a framework, layered detail and natural hair flow that complements the other facial features.

sections.title: A preference for softness, with room for every individual style
paragraphs: Lele personally favours soft, natural brows that retain the character of the original hair, with the softness and restraint of Eastern aesthetics.
But a bespoke service does not mean giving every client the same brows.

Whether you prefer soft and natural brows, a cool and refined look, or clean, strong definition, the design can be tailored to your features, bone structure, personal character and aesthetic preferences.

design_considerations: Facial depth: Look at the relationship between the eyes, nose and lips before deciding how much definition the brows need.
Visual weight and character: Consider the scale and lines of the features when choosing brow thickness and contour.
Cheekbones and facial contour: Consider cheekbone height and facial contours together. Brow position, curvature and contour help balance the visual relationship between the cheekbones and eye area.
Brow bone and eye area: Study the brow bone and the relationship between brows and eyes. Design the start, arch, tail and overall contour with respect for the existing bone structure.
Existing brows and hair direction: Study the shape, density, texture and direction of existing hairs to decide what to retain and where to add detail.
The character you want: Soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined: the design responds to features, bone structure, character and preferences, rather than a fixed template.

services.name: Huapai single-instrument hair-stroke brows
services.description: One instrument is selected for the existing hair texture. Main and supporting strokes refine the outline and hair flow. A possible choice for subtle definition that works with existing brows; suitability depends on the individual design.

services.name: Huapai dual-instrument layered hair-stroke brows
services.original_name: 画派双仪器初绒野生眉
services.description: Two instruments combine main structural strokes with fine strokes. Where this combination is suitable, main strokes establish structure and hair direction, bringing out the visual relationship between brows and brow bone. Fine strokes vary density, tone and definition for natural transitions and the lightness of existing hair. Suitability depends on the individual’s brows and style; the aim is not density alone.

services.name: Manual hair-stroke brows
services.description: Strokes are placed with a manual blade, with pressure and direction controlled by the practitioner. Often considered when there is an established natural brow framework. Colour may look darker during the first week; about seven days is an experience-based recovery guide, not a guaranteed schedule.

services.name: Silk-shaded brows (丝雾眉)
services.description: An available brow service. Discuss the existing brows, underlying pigment and desired definition in person before choosing a technique.

services.name: Velvet-shaded brows (绒雾眉)
services.description: An available brow service. First discuss the preferred contour and colour intensity, then assess whether it suits your brows.

services.name: Lash-line enhancement
services.description: Definition along the lash line. Black gives a stronger visual presence, while brown is softer. Suitability and aftercare are discussed before treatment.

services.name: Lip-contour refinement
services.description: Refines the visual shape and edges of the lips. It does not add tissue volume and is distinct from full-lip colour correction. Surface flaking can occur; about three days is an experience-based guide, with individual variation.

services.name: Dark-lip colour correction
services.description: Assessment-led colour correction for darker lips, with contour refinement where appropriate. Surface flaking can occur. A recovery plan is discussed after assessment rather than assigning the same timeline to everyone.

services.name: Hairline pigmentation
services.description: Hair-like lines follow the existing direction to address some visible gaps or faint edges. Pigmentation does not regrow hair. Large areas of hair loss or substantial repositioning need a different assessment.

services.name: Philtrum shading
services.description: A localised pigmentation service for the philtrum area. Discuss the intended visual detail and suitability first; it does not change bone or tissue structure.

faqs.q: Do you only design soft, natural-looking brows?
faqs.a: No. Lele personally favours soft, natural brows and the restraint of Eastern aesthetics. Bespoke design does not mean one style for everyone: soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined brows can all be considered in relation to your features, bone structure, character and preferences.

Yes. The design consultation is free and usually takes 30–45 minutes. Discuss your brows and preferences, see the proposed shape, then decide whether to proceed. There is no charge if you decide not to.

faqs.q: Where can I check prices and touch-up terms?
faqs.a: Check the studio’s current Dianping listing for prices. All services include free touch-ups within one year. The service and aftercare plan are confirmed before treatment.

faqs.q: Can recovery time or pigment retention be guaranteed?
faqs.a: No. Skin, existing pigment, the procedure and aftercare can affect healing and retention. Any time estimate is an experience-based guide, not a guaranteed result.

faqs.q: Can existing brow pigment be worked over?
faqs.a: The depth, extent and shape of existing pigment must be assessed first. Darker residual pigment may need advice on removal from an appropriately qualified provider. This studio does not offer pigment removal.

faqs.q: How do I arrange a visit?
faqs.a: Contact the studio on WeChat at MiaoMeiHuaMu or call +86 192 8218 2068 to discuss the service and a suitable time. Lele designs and performs the work personally, one client at a time. An appointment is confirmed by the studio’s reply.
